detail.name: hud-entry
detail.method: Freeze engine frame only for paired capture; retain actual scene, HUD veils and scene-menu compositing. First capture visible text; second makes only selected text colors transparent without changing layout. Sample every pixel in tight DOM Range text rectangles. WCAG sRGB luminance contrast uses computed opaque foreground against each captured background pixel, excluding antialiasing from the foreground. Conservative rectangle minimum; scoped to these positions/frames/world only, not all possible backgrounds or full font-rendering legibility.
